metaTitle: Custom Folding Drawstring Backpacks | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom folding drawstring backpacks for your next event. Compact, portable, and ready for your logo. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom folding drawstring backpacks collapse into a small pouch, making them ideal for trade shows, corporate giveaways, and event swag bags. Unlike standard drawstring bags, these pack flat in luggage or a desk drawer until needed. Choose from polyester or nylon materials, with full-color screen printing or embroidery. Perfect for safety managers distributing emergency kits or marketing directors handing out portable brand exposure at conferences.
heroAltText: Custom folding drawstring backpacks in bright colors with company logo, folded into compact pouch for easy carrying
